Original Prologue

The earlier Megatroid-era Prologue records the story's beginnings. It remains preserved as historical source material while the current trilogy canon is reconciled.

Archive status

This text is not silently being rewritten to fit the new canon. Some characters, events, and cosmology details may differ from the current story direction. The current working trilogy account is published separately.

Why keep an archive?

The trilogy's prototypes developed in reverse story order. Preserving the original Prologue keeps that creative history visible while the creator establishes how its events connect to Dayfall, Lightender, and the future Megatroid game.
